To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

REACH is a prototype tool that integrates first-order theories, expertise, and heuristics in a software engineering application, and that REACH can be used by an enterprise database analyst to design accounting views.
REACH can be used to design accounting systems that meet all the design criteria for the REA model.

(1) the REACH tool can be used to automatically generate a database schema from a first-order domain specification, (2) the REACH database schema is an implementation of the REA accounting theory, and (3), the REACH database is a good approximation to an idealized accounting information system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an automated software engineering environment for the development of accounting information systems.
the use of knowledge types in the design of accounting information systems.
how to integrate knowledge of different types to automate the design of enterprise databases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
REACH provides an effective and efficient tool to assist in the design of a relational database for an enterprise accounting information system.

the REACH approach has the potential to significantly enhance the quality of database designs for accounting information systems by providing an integrated environment for the use of domain theory, reconstructive expertise and implementation compromise heurists.
the REA model is a useful conceptual tool for the design of accounting information systems.
